title: Locate Trash Can Icon Usage
description: Identify all instances of the red trash can icon (`Trash2` from `lucide-react`) used for delete actions in the codebase.
details: Search the codebase for `Trash2` imports from `lucide-react`. Focus on files such as `components/ui/data-table.tsx`, `app/dashboard/page.tsx`, and any other components likely to render delete actions. Confirm which instance(s) use a red color class (e.g., `text-red-500`) and are visually too small. Document the file(s) and line(s) for modification.
test_strategy: Verify that all delete action icons are accounted for and that no relevant usage is missed. Cross-check with the UI to ensure all visible trash can icons are identified.

title: Increase Icon Size via Tailwind Classes
description: Update the Tailwind CSS classes on the identified trash can icon(s) to increase their size for better visibility and accessibility.
details: Modify the `className` prop on the `Trash2` icon(s), changing from a smaller size (e.g., `h-4 w-4`) to a larger, consistent size (e.g., `h-6 w-6`). Ensure the new size adheres to the design system and does not use arbitrary values. If the icon is within a button, confirm that the button's padding and alignment remain visually balanced.
test_strategy: Run the app locally and visually inspect the updated icon(s) on all affected screens. Confirm that the icon is larger, more prominent, and does not disrupt the layout. Use browser dev tools to check clickable area size and alignment.

title: Validate UI Consistency and Accessibility
description: Ensure the updated icon size maintains visual consistency and meets accessibility standards across the application.
details: Review the updated icon(s) in context with other interactive icons. Check that the clickable area meets WCAG minimum target size (44x44 CSS pixels) and that the icon remains visually consistent with the design system. Adjust parent component padding or alignment if necessary to preserve layout integrity.
test_strategy: Perform manual visual review on desktop and mobile breakpoints. Use accessibility tools (e.g., axe, Lighthouse) to verify target size and keyboard accessibility. Confirm that the delete action remains functional.

title: Update Visual Regression Snapshots (If Applicable)
description: Update or regenerate any visual regression test snapshots to reflect the new icon size, ensuring automated tests pass.
details: If visual regression testing is in place (e.g., with Chromatic or Storybook), update the relevant snapshots for components containing the trash can icon. Ensure that test baselines match the new, larger icon appearance.
test_strategy: Run the visual regression test suite. Confirm that all updated snapshots are approved and no unintended UI changes are present.
